EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year Month], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Day Type], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Stores'[Store Name], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Products'[Price Band], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Customers'[Loyalty Tier], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Customers'[Value Tier], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Web Sessions'[Device], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Orders'[Order Size], "v", [Avg Pages per Session])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year Month], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Day Type], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Stores'[Store Name], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Products'[Price Band], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Customers'[Loyalty Tier], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Customers'[Value Tier], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Web Sessions'[Device], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Orders'[Order Size], "v", [Products Never Sold Count])

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW("Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Units Sold", [Units Sold], "Margin %", [Margin %], "Revenue per Unit", [Revenue per Unit], "Products Never Sold Count", [Products Never Sold Count], "Unknown Product Orders", [Unknown Product Orders]),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"}),
    'Products'[Category] IN {"Camping", "Hiking"},
    'Products'[List Price] >= 50 && 'Products'[List Price] <= 400
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW("Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Target", [Target], "Target Attainment %", [Target Attainment %], "Return Rate", [Return Rate], "Gross Margin", [Gross Margin]),
    'Stores'[Channel] IN {"Retail", "Outlet"},
    'Stores'[Region] IN {"West"},
    'Date'[Date] >= DATE(2025, 1, 1) && 'Date'[Date] < DATE(2026, 1, 1)
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW("Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Order Count", [Order Count], "Active Customers", [Active Customers], "Customer Count", [Customer Count], "Avg Order Value", [Avg Order Value], "Sessions", [Sessions], "Conversion Rate", [Conversion Rate], "Avg Pages per Session", [Avg Pages per Session], "Sessions (All Devices)", [Sessions (All Devices)]),
    'Stores'[Channel] IN {"Online"},
    'Web Sessions'[Device] IN {"Mobile"},
    NOT ('Customers'[Loyalty Tier] IN {"Unassigned"})
)
